committee.sub: Morning brief · Saturday 19 September 2026 · the committee’s read on the 7am numbers

items.text: Spend last7 climbed to $181.21 from $89.21 prior7 and clicks rose to 28 from 15, but conversions stayed at zero. Post-restart clicks since 8 Sept sit at 41, well short of the 150-click stop-loss trigger.

CTR last7 slipped to 3% from 5.7% prior7 even as impressions jumped to 921 from 265. Rank lost impression share is 75.3% against budget lost of just 18.9%, so the budget conversation still has not opened.

The top organic page, /simpro-xero-integration.html, drew 98 impressions but zero clicks at position 20 (data through 15 Sept, two days behind yesterday). Sessions last7 rose 88% to 60 yet calculator usedLast7 stayed at zero, pointing to a message or page mismatch rather than a traffic problem.

AI Assistant sessions ticked up to 2 from 0 prior7, with chatgpt.com the top source. This almost certainly undercounts real AI-referred traffic since many such clicks land with no referrer in Direct. LinkedIn stayed at zero despite Chris's posting, so tagging on those links is worth checking.

actions.text: Logo and image assets plus keyword-matched RSA headlines for the serving ad groups are still outstanding, get these finalised.
The homepage form confirm-then-count fix is still open so that kontrolTrackLead fires on the Formspree verdict rather than before it.
RSA description D1 still claims 13.3 hours of admin per week, update it to match current site stats.
